honesty: This batch is derived from the live next-in-line queue. Queue items may be in-progress claims, not scoped engineering work; this is not achievement evidence and every item remains blocked until a concrete real-build, code, focused tests, and regenerated evidence prove it.

items.title: Lipi Agent — revives languages & scripts (NLP/OCR/translation)
items.detail: lipi-runtime (real package) provides transliteration/learning/lineage primitives. Agent wrapper does not exist.

items.title: AI Capabilities: Understand (NLU) / Reason & Infer / Generate & Create / Perceive & Interpret / Plan & Decide / Remember & Learn / Act & Automate / Collaborate
items.detail: kbs-runtime/src/{search,claims,reasoning} provides Understand+Reason substrate. visual-hkd-runtime provides Perceive+Interpret for vision boards. Generate/Plan/Act runtimes not present.

items.title: Formats: 120+
items.detail: 120+ file formats is generic count; the repo handles a small subset (HTML, MD, JSON, PNG, etc.). No format conversion runtime.

items.title: Lipi Glyphs Library: 15,000+ glyphs across Brahmi/Kharoshthi/Devanagari/Siddham
items.detail: lipi-runtime/src/characters provides script-character primitives. 15K specific glyph assets are not stored as a library.

items.title: Powered By: LIPI Language & Script
items.detail: lipi-runtime is real; civilizational integration is aspirational.

items.title: ERD: users / profiles / roles / permissions / projects / tasks / milestones / knowledge_nodes / knowledge_relations / knowledge_sources / documents / assets / events
items.detail: lipi-runtime/prisma/schema.prisma contains a real subset (lipi-domain tables). The board's 13-table ERD is broader and not implemented.

items.title: Values Embodied: 12
items.detail: The 12 values (Yamas+Niyamas extended) are catalogued correctly; 'embodied' as a measured property is not defined.

items.title: HKD (Human Knowledge Data) is the universal knowledge format powering the ecosystem
items.detail: visual-hkd-runtime defines an HKD type system and pipeline. It is real but narrow: extraction from visual sources to knowledge-graph projections. It is not (yet) wired as the universal cross-ecosystem format.

items.title: Knowledge Features (Knowledge Graph, Semantic Search, AI Reasoning, Source Attribution, Continuous Learning)
items.detail: kbs-runtime/src/{graph,search,claims,provenance,ingestion} provide the underlying capabilities. 'Continuous Learning' as a runtime is aspirational.

items.title: Lipi Features (Brahmi, Kharoshthi, Devanagari, Multi-direction, RTL/LTR/TTB, Custom Fonts, Lipi Learning Engine)
items.detail: lipi-runtime/src/{characters,phonetics,registry,learning,search,governance} implement many of these. Indus Script Research is marked '(Research)' on board image 1 — appropriate.

items.title: Policy Lifecycle: Draft→Consult→Vote→Enact→Implement→Review→Evolve
items.detail: kbs-governance has policy primitives (evaluateKbsGate, rejectProductionClaim). scripts/governed-production-gate.mjs implements an Enact→Implement gate for releases. Full lifecycle is not wired.

items.title: 9 HKD Entity Types: Concept / Entity / Person / Event / Location / Asset / Document / Observation / Evidence
items.detail: VisualHKD's HKDNode has a `kind: string` field — entity types are user-defined. The 9 named types are a sensible taxonomy but not encoded in the type system.
